messages:
Sanjay: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to consolidate action items for multi-region routing, backups, and restore runbooks. Can owners confirm timelines?
Elaine: I can own multi-region routing (GSLB + region weights). Targeting sprint end (2 weeks). Will post config PR.
Maria: I'll take backups and snapshot validation. Need to formalize cross-region snapshot restore test cadence.
Dave: I'll pair with Maria on the restore runbook and run the first dry-run during game day.
Lina: OpsBot scheduled game day for 2026-04-10 at 09:00 PT — I can coordinate invites.
Sanjay: Thanks. For routing, Elaine — can you add automated health-check failover policy? Prefer weighted failover + 30s probe.
Elaine: Yep. Proposed health-check snippet in the console:
```
probe:
  path: /healthz
  interval: 10s
  threshold: 3
policy:
  type: weighted
  fallback: nearest-region
```
Maria: For backups: daily snapshots, hourly WAL shipping for critical DBs, and weekly cross-region restores. Add retention note: 30 days.
Dave: Restore runbook draft actions:
- promote read-replica
- update DNS via GSLB to new region
- sanity tests (api health, DB integrity, kv-store read)
I'll put the step-by-step in the runbook doc.
Sanjay: Ownership recap: Elaine (routing) — due 2026-04-03; Maria (backups) — due 2026-04-05; Dave (runbook + dry-run) — game day 2026-04-10.
Lina: I've created a recurring calendar called 'Resiliency Sprint' and added owners. OpsBot: please post reminders 48h and 2h before.
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-04-08T09:00:00Z (48h), 2026-04-10T07:00:00Z (2h).
Elaine: I'll open a PR for the GSLB policy and upload simulation logs.
Maria: Plan to run a scripted cross-region restore next Tuesday in staging and report outcomes.
Dave: On the game day I'll be oncall in #eng-oncall, Elaine will be in #eng-runtime for routing changes.
Sanjay: One more: capture recurring patterns — we saw slow failover because health-check TTLs were too long. Add action item to standardize probe intervals across services.
Elaine: Adding 'standardize probe intervals' to my PR checklist.
Sanjay: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after the dry-run. :thumbsup:
